pokemon_species.rule: Extract ID/Name from GBA. Map to PMDO internal species string. DO NOT export sprites, stats, portraits, or typings.

moves_skills.rule: Use PMDC SkillData. Extract base power, accuracy, PP if rebalancing is needed. Ignore targeting AI.

combat_ai.rule: Discard GBA routines. Use PMDC AITactics.

weather.rule: Map GBA weather flags to PMDO MapStatus IDs. Do not recreate mechanics.

dungeon_generation.rule: Ignore GBA generation algorithm. Extract Floor count, Pokemon SpawnLists, Item tables. Generate RogueElements FloorPlan XML.

ground_maps.rule: Extract BMA, BPC, BPL. Output perfectly compliant .rsground and .tile. Calculate accurate collision matrices.

cinematics.rule: Extract timings, cameras, flashes, VFX, SFX, BGM, movements. Strip narrative text. Convert to pure Lua GAME/GROUND/SOUND API calls.

items.rule: Check if item exists in PMDC. If yes: map reference. If no: extract ItemData, icon, ground sprite, and effects.
